What I searched: a corpus-wide query for “overall materiality”, “materiality 2023 audit report”, and similar terms in the docs corpus.

Why not found: the likely source (audit/audit-report-2023.pdf) could not be read — omniweave reported the file as encrypted and refused to parse it. Exact message returned:

To proceed I need the decrypted document or its password so the report can be indexed and I can extract the overall materiality and page reference.
